title: Uniform asymptotics and entropy structure of the Bingham distribution in arbitrary dimensions
summary: The Bingham distribution is widely used to model directional data with antipodal symmetry, and its normalizing constant $Z$ and moments play a central role in statistical inference and closure models. Their behavior becomes singular when one or more eigenvalue gaps of the parameter matrix become unbounded. In this work, we develop a uniform asymptotic framework for the Bingham distribution in arbitrary dimensions.
